text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 alert — eu-west serving runtime: GPU OOM spike + autoscaler thrash causing pod crashloops. Visible errors: `CUDARuntimeError: out of memory`, kube evictions, 5% error rate increase on /v1/generate. Pager: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

alex (oncall): Ack. I'm on it. @maya can you join? I'm seeing autoscaler scale 6 -> 18 -> 4 in ~2m.

maya (eng-infra): joining. looking at HPA logs now. early signs of reactive scaling: scale-up then immediate pod evictions due to node pressure -> backoff -> repeat.

sam (eng-runtime): runtime logs show repeated `cudaMalloc` OOM in worker loops, then kube kills. also seeing crashloops on pods with larger batch size. any recent model or config deploy?

ben (eng-platform): no deploys since 11:20 UTC. I see a burst of traffic from API key cust_42 — lots of long-context requests. can throttle at gateway.

alex (oncall): good call. @ben can you apply a temporary rate-limit to cust_42 to 5 rps? Example: `curl -X POST https://console.internal/gateway/limits -d '{"key":"cust_42","rps":5}'` (pseudo)

ben (eng-platform): applied limit for cust_42, will monitor metrics.

rita (ops lead): sanity check: should we disable autoscaler to stop oscillation? risk: might run out of capacity under sustained load. alternate: set minReplicas=6 and increase stabilization window.

maya (eng-infra): propose: set autoscaler stabilization to 300s and increase cool-down, reduce max surge. applying patch now:

```
kubectl patch hpa serving-runtime -p '{"spec":{"behavior":{"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":300},"scaleUp":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":300}}}}'
```

maya (eng-infra): patched, changes rolling in (30s). cordoning node-7 which shows repeated kernel OOMs.

sam (eng-runtime): restarting runtime pods with reduced BATCH_SIZE to mitigate OOMs:

```
kubectl set env deployment/serving-runtime BATCH_SIZE=2
```

sam (eng-runtime): pods restarted, initial logs show lower memory footprint, fewer OOMs.

maya (eng-infra): kubelet eviction spikes at 11:19:42 — memory.available dropped below threshold on node-7 and node-9. cordoned node-7; draining node-9 now.

alex (oncall): customer-impact: 5xxs peaked at ~8% for ~12 minutes, latency SLO breaches observed. @lee start CS status draft.

lee (customer-success): drafting status page: "We are investigating increased errors and latency for text-generation in EU-WEST. Root cause under investigation: autoscaler and memory pressure on GPU hosts." Will post update in ~10m.

ben (eng-platform): observed request fan-out where huge context requests cause repeated KV-cache rebuilds; caching TTL disabled for some model variants. re-enabling prefix KV cache for model-v2 now.

sam (eng-runtime): enabling KV cache reduced token compute ~40% in staging. rolling config to prod.

incident-bot: Auto-remediation applied: scaled deployment to stable 6-10 range with new stabilization settings. Logs: https://kibana.internal/logs?query=INC12345

maya (eng-infra): after changes, error rate down to 0.8%, latency back within SLO for new requests. node pressure easing. continuing to monitor for 20m.

rita (ops lead): handoff plan for +30m: keep HPA stabilization=300s, keep BATCH_SIZE=2, KV cache enabled. if error rate >1.5% rollback and escalate to runtime. @alex you'll hand off to @sam in 30.

alex (oncall): oncall handoff — leaving for short break in 25m. Sam will take over. Summary: chain: large long-context traffic (cust_42) -> memory pressure -> autoscaler reacted rapidly -> node churn -> pod evictions -> crashloops. Mitigations: rate-limited customer, patched HPA stabilization, set BATCH_SIZE=2, re-enabled KV cache, cordoned node-7, drained node-9. metrics stabilizing.

sam (eng-runtime): ack. I'll watch logs, push hotfix to add backpressure for huge contexts and adjust mem limits.

lee (customer-success): posted update at 11:45 UTC. customers asking ETA; looping in product for prioritized communication.

alex (oncall): closing pager for now but leaving thread open until 12:15 UTC. :white_check_mark:

maya (eng-infra): leaving runbook note: add autoscaler damping config for serving-runtime to prevent immediate scale-down after scale-up. Ticket filed INFRA-897.

ben (eng-platform): capturing request fingerprinting to auto-block heavy sessions, ticket PLAT-432.

rita (ops lead): postmortem plan: timeline, cust_42 request pattern, autoscaler tuning, kernel-oom evidence, mitigations and CS impact. scheduling postmortem tomorrow 09:30 UTC.

sam (eng-runtime): adding logs + flamegraphs to postmortem doc: https://docs.internal/postmortems/INC12345

alex (oncall): thanks team — ping if any regression.

End of thread.
